brief.electrical_scope_summary: G3 carries selective electrical demolition and make-safe work, pharmacy receptacles and branch-circuit extensions, modifications to existing panelboards, new lighting and controls, six fire/smoke-damper power connections and the explicitly shown VV-2-N connection. Carry temporary electrical services, electrical restoration, healthcare grounding and branch separation, essential-power commissioning and the hospital coordination-study update. Fire alarm is design-build with Honeywell coordination; its vendor/subcontract boundary remains unresolved. Communications rough-ins and furniture infrastructure connections are required, while E0.01 assigns communications cabling and devices to others. Exhibit A separately requires removal, storage and reinstallation of existing telemetry, Centrak and wireless access devices. The BOQ is a quantified-device baseline, not a complete material takeoff: branch wire/conduit footage, complete demolition lighting totals, L5 lengths and several vendor-designed systems remain unquantified.
other_trades_affecting_electrical: Mechanical furnishes six new smoke/fire dampers; E0.01 generally calls for 120V emergency control power, maximum ten devices per circuit. Actual actuator loads and interfaces remain unconfirmed.
Mechanical furnishes TITUS ESV VV-1-N and VV-2-N, both hydronic reheat, not electric heat. Electrical schedule data are absent; E2.01 explicitly depicts only VV-2-N connection.
Mechanical/controls handles five thermostat relocations and two new sensor locations under M0.01 ATC scope; sensors mount 48 inches AFF with locking covers.

FA duct detectors are furnished/wired by FA and installed by mechanical; standalone detectors are mechanical scope. Electrical conditionally furnishes separate detector access doors for mechanical installation.
Mechanical removes one existing SFD; G3 must coordinate electrical isolation and FA disposition. Nineteen existing SFDs remain.
